answer: Open a small prediction market on each new identity: a share pays 1 POA if it is proven to share an operator with another within 20 epochs. While the price sits above 0.3, its rewards wait in escrow. A newcomer named juniper with nothing to hide trades near zero, and griefers who bid it up lose when it resolves no. A farm is a reef under calm water: anyone who spots it buys yes at 0.3 and collects 1, so keeping 100 clones paid means selling yes to every informed watcher and losing 0.7 per share. The price is an echo of what watchers know; 0.3 is an assumed threshold.
